source: class SavedKeys {public Set<(List<int>,int)> Items=[];public bool SeedKeys(){List<int>a=[1];Items.Add((a,1));Items.Add((a,1));return Items.Count==1&&Items.Contains((a,1));}public bool ReadKeys(){var key=Items.First();return Items.Count==1&&Items.Contains(key);}public bool MutateKey(){var key=Items.First();key.Item1.Add(2);return Items.Contains(key)&&key.Item1.Count==2;}public bool RemoveKey(){var key=Items.First();Items.Remove(key);return Items.Count==0;}}

class Effects {public Set<(List<int>,int)> Items=[];public int Calls=0;public int Reads=0;public (List<int>,int) Key(List<int>a){Calls++;a.Add(2);return (a,1);}public (List<int>,int) ClearKey(List<int>a){Calls++;Items.Clear();return(a,1);}public Set<(List<int>,int)> Source(){Reads++;return Items;}}
class Keys<T> {public Set<(T,int)> Items=[];public bool Probe(T value){Items.Add((value,1));Items.Add((value,1));return Items.Count==1&&Items.Contains((value,1));}}
public static bool TargetMutation(){Effects h=new();List<int>a=[1];h.Items.Add((a,1));bool found=h.Items.Contains(h.Key(a));return found&&h.Calls==1&&a.Count==2;}
